keyFindings.description: The one line that makes the feature work in a pod is locked by no test. TestWorkerShimStartsAPodsAgentOnTheBaselineAndAPanesAsBefore (worker_shim_test.go:305-388) asserts only $3, the profile directory under the state home, and the environment it runs the shim under sets none of podsafety.ScratchVariables, so EnsureScratch is a no-op in it. Deleting podsafety.EnsureScratch(environ) leaves the whole repository green while every role's first mktemp fails in a pod. The machinery is already there: a $4 for TMPDIR's directory, asserted [ -d "$4" ] for the pod row and absent for the pane row, and/or one test -d on the agent's TMPDIR in checkPodBaseline (live_operator_test.go:197-201). The test's doc comment at worker_shim_test.go:298-304 still describes the state home alone.

CheckPod's refusal for a mount at, under or above /home/legion/.local/state still reads "every role's agent keeps its Oh My Pi state under" / "the agents' state home", which this change made false: the doc comment eight lines above (operatorpod.go:83-88) and docs/kubernetes.md:3014-3021 were both rewritten in this PR to say the opposite — that path is the setup container's state home and no role's agent keeps state there any more. The refusal itself is still right; only the operator-facing explanation names the wrong owner and sends the operator to the wrong place. The stale wording is pinned by operatorpod_test.go:42 and :114-116, so both strings and those assertions move together.

The sentence an operator sizes issue_volume from is stale, inside the paragraph this PR edited. It still reads "issue_volume sizes each issue's own volume, the clone, the workspace, uv's Pythons and packages, and the roles' sessions on it" while lines 1197-1199, four lines below and changed by this PR, put the temporary directory, the three homes and the Go and bun caches on that same volume. The new section at 1767-1795 measures the per-role figures (297 MB Go build, 192 MB Go module, ~400 MB Playwright, 1.4 GB bun) but never connects them to issue_volume, and defaultIssueVolume (config/kubernetes.go:215) stays 20Gi with nothing pruning /legion/scratch. The human's open sizing decision (dispatch://INFRA-31 ask 0983e1d7) is read from this sentence.

"the two setup containers" is wrong in three new comments and two new doc lines; the wording this PR replaced ("workspace-init") was right. xdgEnvironment() has exactly one caller, initEnvironment (manifest.go:801); fetchEnvironment (manifest.go:773-781) is told PATH, its own TMPDIR and two token paths and no XDG variable at all. Same error at manifest.go:679-680, operatorpod.go:84, docs/kubernetes.md:1724-1726 and packages/pi-legion/CHANGELOG.md:87. The PR's own new assertions agree with the code rather than the comment: manifest_test.go:520-525 and 580-583 read containerNamed(..., initContainer) only.

The pull request carries no `## Contract change census`. It adds a boot refusal (four names into runtimeOwned, manifest.go:91) and moves the daemon-to-image contract 32 to 33, both of which the census rule covers. The substance is sound — I ran the searches at this head and every hit is disposed: `grep -rn -E '\b(TMPDIR|GOCACHE|GOMODCACHE|BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR)\b' deploy/ packages/daemon/docker/ .github/` finds no deployment file, Dockerfile, workflow or legion.yaml example setting any of the four, and `grep -rln daemonApiVersion --include=package.json --include='*.json' packages/` finds exactly three declarers (packages/contracts/fixtures/daemon-api/version.json, packages/pi-legion/package.json, packages/claude-envoy/package.json), all at 33 — so what is missing is the section and its re-runnable commands, not the work. The rollout is an immediate refusal, which the body already argues for from the architect's read of the deployment.

thermonuclear.deepReview: 6 findings: 1 High (the PVC now absorbs unbounded, never-pruned per-role caches with no eviction signal while 20Gi and the sizing paragraph are unchanged), 1 Medium (an agent-run bun install hardlinks the role's persistent cache into the shared workspace — reproduced in this pod), 3 Low, 1 hardening. Clean: the 32→33 contract consistency, the operator mount fence, probe-image and tmux, EnsureScratch's skip rules, the unchanged golden manifests, stale plugin generations.
thermonuclear.codeQuality: 11 findings. The three I carried are F1 (untested wiring), F5 (the stale issue_volume sizing sentence) and F7 ("the two setup containers"), plus F6 which is the same defect as the deep review's finding 4. Not carried: F2/F3 (ScratchVariables as a shared list rather than a prefix rule), F4 (per-role GOCACHE/GOMODCACHE against the shared UV_CACHE_DIR precedent) and F9 (four spellings of the short-socket helper) — F4 is a design question sent to the architect, F9 is the PR's own Fast-follow line, F2/F3 are a defensible shape with a non-vacuous coupling test (workerOf merges the pod template's env with the launcher start command's pairs, so both drift directions fail).
